item.title: Text Messages Exposed Abuse by Shanda Vander Ark
item.description: Text messages between Shanda Vander Ark and her older son revealed how they treated 15-year-old Timothy Ferguson before his death in July 2022. The case exposed prolonged abuse and starvation, leading to Vander Ark’s murder conviction and a sentence of life without parole.

item.title: A Missing License Plate Led Police to Joel Rifkin
item.description: In June 1993, a missing license plate drew police attention to Joel Rifkin’s pickup truck. Inside, officers discovered the body of 22-year-old Tiffany Bresciani. His arrest led to confessions to 17 killings, exposing a series of murders that had gone undetected for years.

item.title: How Robert Bardo Tracked Down Rebecca Schaeffer
item.description: Robert Bardo paid a private investigator to find actress Rebecca Schaeffer’s home address before killing her in 1989. The Vile Eye examines his fixation, the escalation from fan letters to stalking, and the choices that culminated in her murder.

item.title: DNA Linked David Fuller to Two Murders Decades Later
item.description: DNA evidence linked David Fuller to the 1987 murders of Wendy Knell and Caroline Pierce. The investigation also uncovered years of abuse in hospital mortuaries, leading to a whole-life sentence and an inquiry into the failures that allowed his crimes to go undetected.

item.title: Malcolm Webster Staged Car Crashes for Insurance Money
item.description: Malcolm Webster murdered his first wife, Claire Morris, in a staged crash in Scotland in 1994. Five years later, he tried to kill his second wife, Felicity Drumm, in New Zealand. Both attacks formed part of insurance schemes that led to his conviction and life sentence in 2011.
